text_en: In the twelfth year of King Ahaz of Judah, Hoshea son of Elah began to reign in Samaria over Israel; he reigned nine years.
text_cn: 犹大王阿哈次十二年，厄拉的儿子曷舍亚在撒玛黎雅登极为以色列王，在位凡九年。

text_en: He did what was evil in the sight of the Lord , yet not like the kings of Israel who were before him.
text_cn: 他行了上主视为恶的事，但不像他以前的以色列列王。

text_en: King Shalmaneser of Assyria came up against him; Hoshea became his vassal, and paid him tribute.
text_cn: 亚述王沙耳玛乃色上来攻打曷舍亚，他便向亚述王称臣纳贡。

text_en: But the king of Assyria found treachery in Hoshea; for he had sent messengers to King So of Egypt, and offered no tribute to the king of Assyria, as he had done year by year; therefore the king of Assyria confined him and imprisoned him.
text_cn: 后来亚述王发觉曷舍亚企图造反。原来曷舍亚曾派使者去见埃及王索阿，就不再向亚述王每年纳贡，所以亚述王将他拘捕，囚在监里。

text_en: Then the king of Assyria invaded all the land and came to Samaria; for three years he besieged it.
text_cn: 随后，亚述王进军侵入全国，直逼撒玛黎雅，围攻了三年，

text_en: In the ninth year of Hoshea the king of Assyria captured Samaria; he carried the Israelites away to Assyria. He placed them in Halah, on the Habor, the river of Gozan, and in the cities of the Medes.
text_cn: 曷舍亚九年，亚述王攻陷了撒玛黎雅，把以色列人掳往亚述，把他们安置在哈拉黑和靠近哥仓河的哈波尔，以及玛待各城。

text_en: This occurred because the people of Israel had sinned against the Lord their God, who had brought them up out of the land of Egypt from under the hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt. They had worshiped other gods
text_cn: 这是因为以色列子民犯罪，得罪了领他们离开埃及地，摆脱埃及王法郎之手的上主，他们的天主，而去敬拜了别的神，

text_en: and walked in the customs of the nations whom the Lord drove out before the people of Israel, and in the customs that the kings of Israel had introduced.
text_cn: 随从了上主由以色列子民面前，所驱逐的异民的习俗，和以色列列王所规定的律例。

text_en: The people of Israel secretly did things that were not right against the Lord their God. They built for themselves high places at all their towns, from watchtower to fortified city;
text_cn: 以色列子民作了不义的事，得罪了上主他们的天主：在他们所有的城中，从守望台直到设防的城，到处建有高丘；

text_en: they set up for themselves pillars and sacred poles on every high hill and under every green tree;
text_cn: 在各高岗上，在所有的绿树下，竖有石柱和木偶；

text_en: there they made offerings on all the high places, as the nations did whom the Lord carried away before them. They did wicked things, provoking the Lord to anger;
text_cn: 在高丘上，依照上主从他们面前所驱逐的异民的习俗，焚香献祭，作恶激怒上主；

text_en: they served idols, of which the Lord had said to them, “You shall not do this. ”
text_cn: 又敬拜偶像，虽然天主曾明明吩咐他们说：你们不可行这样的事！

text_en: Yet the Lord warned Israel and Judah by every prophet and every seer, saying, “Turn from your evil ways and keep my commandments and my statutes, in accordance with all the law that I commanded your ancestors and that I sent to you by my servants the prophets. ”
text_cn: 上主曾藉众先知和先见者警告以色列和犹大说：“你们应离弃你们的邪道，按照我给你们祖先所规定的，藉我的仆人，众先知给你们传授的一切法律，遵守我的诫命和我的法令。”

text_en: They would not listen but were stubborn, as their ancestors had been, who did not believe in the Lord their God.
text_cn: 他们却不听从，如同他们的祖先一样执拗，不肯相信上主他们的天主，

text_en: They despised his statutes, and his covenant that he made with their ancestors, and the warnings that he gave them. They went after false idols and became false; they followed the nations that were around them, concerning whom the Lord had commanded them that they should not do as they did.
text_cn: 拒绝了上主的法律和他与他们的祖先所订立的盟约，以及对他们所发出的警告；随从他们四周上主曾命令他们不可效法的异民，追求虚无，自己成为虚无；

text_en: They rejected all the commandments of the Lord their God and made for themselves cast images of two calves; they made a sacred pole, worshiped all the host of heaven, and served Baal.
text_cn: 抛弃了上主他们天主的一切命令，为自己铸造神像，即两个牛犊，制造木偶，敬拜天上万象，事奉巴耳，

text_en: They made their sons and their daughters pass through fire; they used divination and augury; and they sold themselves to do evil in the sight of the Lord , provoking him to anger.
text_cn: 使儿女经火献神，行占卜和法术，出卖自己，行上主视为恶的事，激怒上主；

text_en: Therefore the Lord was very angry with Israel and removed them out of his sight; none was left but the tribe of Judah alone.
text_cn: 因此，上主对以色列大发愤怒，将他们从自己面前赶走，只留下了犹大支派。

text_en: Judah also did not keep the commandments of the Lord their God but walked in the customs that Israel had introduced.
text_cn: 但是，犹大也没有遵守上主，他们天主的命令，反而也随从了以色列所行的习俗。

text_en: The Lord rejected all the descendants of Israel; he punished them and gave them into the hand of plunderers, until he had banished them from his presence.
text_cn: 为此，上主抛弃了以色列所有的后裔，使他们受压迫，任人宰割，终于将他们从自己面前赶走。

text_en: When he had torn Israel from the house of David, they made Jeroboam son of Nebat king. Jeroboam drove Israel from following the Lord and made them commit great sin.
text_cn: 的确，自从上主使以色列与达味家分裂以后，以色列便立了乃巴特的儿子雅洛贝罕为王；雅洛贝罕即引以色列远离了上主，使他们陷于重罪。

text_en: The people of Israel continued in all the sins that Jeroboam committed; they did not depart from them
text_cn: 以色列子民遂追随雅洛贝罕所犯的一切罪恶，始终没有离开，

text_en: until the Lord removed Israel out of his sight, as he had foretold through all his servants the prophets. So Israel was exiled from their own land to Assyria until this day.
text_cn: 直到上主将以色列从自己面前赶走，正如上主藉自己的仆人众先知说的话。因此，以色列由本国被掳往亚述，直到今日。

text_en: The king of Assyria brought people from Babylon, Cuthah, Avva, Hamath, and Sepharvaim, and placed them in the cities of Samaria in place of the people of Israel; they took possession of Samaria, and settled in its cities.
text_cn: 亚述王从巴比伦、雇特、阿瓦、哈玛特和色法瓦因徙置一些人民，住在撒玛黎雅各城，以代替以色列人；这些人占据了撒玛黎雅，就住在各城内。

text_en: When they first settled there, they did not worship the Lord ; therefore the Lord sent lions among them, which killed some of them.
text_cn: 他们起初住在那里的时候，因为不敬畏上主，所以上主打发狮子来，咬死了他们一些人。

text_en: So the king of Assyria was told, “The nations that you have carried away and placed in the cities of Samaria do not know the law of the god of the land; therefore he has sent lions among them; they are killing them, because they do not know the law of the god of the land. ”
text_cn: 有人报告亚述王说：“你在撒玛黎雅各城徙置的人民，不知敬拜土神的礼仪，因此那神打发狮子来咬死了他们一些人，因为他们不知敬拜土神的礼仪。”

text_en: Then the king of Assyria commanded, “Send there one of the priests whom you carried away from there; let him go and live there, and teach them the law of the god of the land. ”
text_cn: 亚述王于是下令说：“你们叫一个从撒玛黎雅掳来的司祭回去，住在那里，教给他们敬拜土神的礼仪。”

text_en: So one of the priests whom they had carried away from Samaria came and lived in Bethel; he taught them how they should worship the Lord .
text_cn: 于是，有一个从撒玛黎雅掳去的司祭回来，住在贝特耳，教给他们该怎样敬拜雅威。

text_en: But every nation still made gods of its own and put them in the shrines of the high places that the people of Samaria had made, every nation in the cities in which they lived;
text_cn: 虽然如此，各个民族仍然制造自己的神，供在撒玛黎雅人所建筑的高丘上的庙宇中；各个民族在自己所住的城内，供着自己的神。

text_en: the people of Babylon made Succoth-benoth, the people of Cuth made Nergal, the people of Hamath made Ashima;
text_cn: 巴比伦人制造了稣苛特贝诺特，雇特人制造了乃尔加耳，哈玛特人制造了阿史玛，

text_en: the Avvites made Nibhaz and Tartak; the Sepharvites burned their children in the fire to Adrammelech and Anammelech, the gods of Sepharvaim.
text_cn: 阿瓦人制造了尼贝哈次和塔尔塔克，色法瓦因人使儿女经火，献于色法瓦因的神阿德辣默肋客和阿纳默肋客；

text_en: They also worshiped the Lord and appointed from among themselves all sorts of people as priests of the high places, who sacrificed for them in the shrines of the high places.
text_cn: 同时他们也敬拜上主，从自己中间选派一些人作高丘上的司祭，在高丘上的庙宇内自己献祭。

text_en: So they worshiped the Lord but also served their own gods, after the manner of the nations from among whom they had been carried away.
text_cn: 这样，他们也敬拜上主，也奉事自己的神，从那一国徙置来的，就照那一国的礼仪。

text_en: To this day they continue to practice their former customs. They do not worship the Lord and they do not follow the statutes or the ordinances or the law or the commandment that the Lord commanded the children of Jacob, whom he named Israel.
text_cn: 直到今日，他们仍然依照先前的礼仪而行。雅各伯──上主给他改名为以色列──的子孙，也不全心敬畏上主，也不按照上主给他们所立的条例、礼仪、法律和诫命而行。

text_en: The Lord had made a covenant with them and commanded them, “You shall not worship other gods or bow yourselves to them or serve them or sacrifice to them,
text_cn: 上主曾与他们立约，吩咐他们说：“你们不可敬拜别的神，也不可跪拜，也不可事奉，也不可向他们献祭；

text_en: but you shall worship the Lord , who brought you out of the land of Egypt with great power and with an outstretched arm; you shall bow yourselves to him, and to him you shall sacrifice.
text_cn: 只应敬拜那以强力和伸展的手臂，领你们离开埃及地的上主，只应向他跪拜，向他献祭。

text_en: The statutes and the ordinances and the law and the commandment that he wrote for you, you shall always be careful to observe. You shall not worship other gods;
text_cn: 我为你们写定的条例、礼仪、法律和诫命，要时常谨守遵行，不可敬拜别的神。

text_en: you shall not forget the covenant that I have made with you. You shall not worship other gods,
text_cn: 我与你们立的盟约，不要忘记，也不要敬拜别的神，

text_en: but you shall worship the Lord your God; he will deliver you out of the hand of all your enemies. ”
text_cn: 只应敬拜上主你们的天主，他必拯救你们脱离你们一切仇敌的权势。”

text_en: They would not listen, however, but they continued to practice their former custom.
text_cn: 然而，他们不听，仍然依照他们先前的礼仪而行。

text_en: So these nations worshiped the Lord , but also served their carved images; to this day their children and their children’s children continue to do as their ancestors did.
text_cn: 这样，这些人民敬拜上主，又事奉他们的雕像；他们的子子孙孙也是如此：祖先怎样行，子孙也怎样行，直到今日。
